principles: Full de-koala per user decision: change all koala variants including historical technical tokens.
Case-preserving substitution to keep prose readable.
Pure-docs scope: CHANGELOG.md only, no code/test.
drivers: Clean OSS-facing changelog with zero koala.
User accepted non-literal history as the tradeoff.
No impact on code/tests (CHANGELOG excluded from gate).

options.name: A: full case-preserving koala->lattice substitution across CHANGELOG.md
B: brand-only (keep historical technical tokens)
cons: User rejected this; wanted full de-koala

chosen: A: full case-preserving koala->lattice substitution across CHANGELOG.md
rationale: User explicitly chose full de-koala over brand-only/truthful-history. Case-preserving substitution across CHANGELOG.md yields a zero-koala OSS changelog. Option B (brand-only) was the original ship-clean choice but the user overrode it.

preMortem.scenario: A koala->lattice substitution corrupts a non-brand word or breaks markdown
preMortem.trigger: overly broad regex hits an unintended substring
preMortem.mitigation: koala is a distinctive token; review the diff; case-preserving s/koala/lattice/ only affects koala-containing words; build/validate confirm no breakage

preMortem.scenario: Some koala remains (a missed case variant)
preMortem.trigger: a casing not covered (e.g. KOALA in a code block)
preMortem.mitigation: acceptance git grep -i koala CHANGELOG.md must return 0; iterate if any remain

preMortem.scenario: The change re-introduces koala into active gate scope
preMortem.trigger: n/a - CHANGELOG is excluded from the gate
preMortem.mitigation: gate EXCLUDE_EXACT covers CHANGELOG.md; verified at INIT
